```{r}
# ============================================
# GAP-FILLING WITH DISCRETE SAMPLE
# ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

fill_gap_with_discrete <- function(df, 
                                   gap_start = as.Date("2025-04-27"),
                                   gap_end = as.Date("2025-05-11"),
                                   discrete_date = as.Date("2025-05-02"),
                                   discrete_value = 11.61,
                                   interpolation_method = "gaussian") {
  
  # Validate inputs
  if (discrete_date <= gap_start || discrete_date >= gap_end) {
    stop("Discrete sample date must be within the gap period")
  }
  
  # Find boundary values (last before gap, first after gap)
  before_gap <- df %>%
    filter(date <= gap_start) %>%
    arrange(desc(date)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(fl_med_day)
  
  after_gap <- df %>%
    filter(date >= gap_end) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(fl_med_day)
  
  # Create date sequence for gap
  gap_dates <- seq(gap_start + days(1), gap_end - days(1), by = "day")
  
  if (interpolation_method == "gaussian") {
    # Gaussian curve centered on discrete sample
    # This mimics a bloom peak with asymmetric rise/fall
    
    # Days from gap start
    days_from_start <- as.numeric(discrete_date - gap_start)
    total_gap_days <- as.numeric(gap_end - gap_start)
    
    # Calculate standard deviations for asymmetric curve
    # Rising phase is typically faster than declining phase for diatom blooms
    sd_rise <- days_from_start * 0.5  # Faster rise
    sd_fall <- (total_gap_days - days_from_start) * 0.6  # Slower decline
    
    # Generate values
    gap_values <- sapply(gap_dates, function(d) {
      days_from_discrete <- as.numeric(d - discrete_date)
      
      if (days_from_discrete <= 0) {
        # Rising phase (before peak)
        amplitude <- discrete_value - before_gap
        gaussian <- amplitude * exp(-(days_from_discrete^2) / (2 * sd_rise^2))
        return(before_gap + gaussian)
      } else {
        # Falling phase (after peak)
        amplitude <- discrete_value - after_gap
        gaussian <- amplitude * exp(-(days_from_discrete^2) / (2 * sd_fall^2))
        return(after_gap + gaussian)
      }
    })
    
  } else if (interpolation_method == "spline") {
    # Cubic spline through three points
    x_points <- c(as.numeric(gap_start), 
                  as.numeric(discrete_date), 
                  as.numeric(gap_end))
    y_points <- c(before_gap, discrete_value, after_gap)
    
    spline_fit <- spline(x_points, y_points, 
                        xout = as.numeric(gap_dates),
                        method = "natural")
    gap_values <- spline_fit$y
    
  } else if (interpolation_method == "asymmetric") {
    # Exponential rise, linear fall (typical diatom bloom)
    
    days_to_peak <- as.numeric(discrete_date - gap_start - 1)
    days_from_peak <- as.numeric(gap_end - discrete_date - 1)
    
    gap_values <- sapply(gap_dates, function(d) {
      if (d <= discrete_date) {
        # Exponential rise
        t <- as.numeric(d - gap_start) / days_to_peak
        rise <- (discrete_value - before_gap) * (exp(2*t) - 1) / (exp(2) - 1)
        return(before_gap + rise)
      } else {
        # Linear decline with slight curve
        t <- as.numeric(d - discrete_date) / days_from_peak
        fall <- (discrete_value - after_gap) * (1 - t^1.5)  # Slightly curved
        return(after_gap + fall)
      }
    })
  }
  
  # Create gap-filled dataframe
  gap_filled_data <- data.frame(
    date = gap_dates,
    fl_med_day = gap_values,
    gap_filled = TRUE,
    discrete_anchor = gap_dates == discrete_date
  )
  
  # Add discrete sample point
  discrete_row <- data.frame(
    date = discrete_date,
    fl_med_day = discrete_value,
    gap_filled = FALSE,
    discrete_anchor = TRUE
  )
  
  # Combine with original data
  df_original <- df %>%
    mutate(gap_filled = FALSE, discrete_anchor = FALSE)
  
  result <- bind_rows(df_original, gap_filled_data) %>%
    filter(!(date > gap_start & date < gap_end & !gap_filled)) %>%  # Remove original gap
    arrange(date)
  
  # Add the discrete point (overwrite interpolated value at that date)
  result <- result %>%
    filter(date != discrete_date) %>%
    bind_rows(discrete_row) %>%
    arrange(date)
  
  # Report summary
  cat("\n=== GAP-FILLING SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Gap period: %s to %s (%d days)\n", 
              gap_start, gap_end, length(gap_dates)))
  cat(sprintf("Discrete sample: %s = %.2f mg/m³\n", 
              discrete_date, discrete_value))
  cat(sprintf("Before gap: %.2f | After gap: %.2f\n", 
              before_gap, after_gap))
  cat(sprintf("Interpolation method: %s\n", interpolation_method))
  cat(sprintf("Days filled: %d\n\n", sum(result$gap_filled)))
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# ── 1. Process new hourly wind data ──────────────────────────────────────────

wind_new_processed <- wind %>%
  mutate(
    time       = mdy_hm(measurementTime),   # "mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm"
    date       = date(time),
    wind_speed = WindSpd_Avg,               # already in m/s - verify units!
    wind_dir   = WindDir_Avg
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wind_speed), !is.na(wind_dir)) %>%
  select(time, date, wind_speed, wind_dir) %>%
  arrange(time)

cat("Date range:", as.character(min(wind_new_processed$date)), "to",
    as.character(max(wind_new_processed$date)), "\n")
cat("Records:", nrow(wind_new_processed), "\n")

# ── 2. Wind stress + speed cubed ─────────────────────────────────────────────

calculate_drag_coefficient_colleague <- function(wind_speed) {
  cd <- (1.11 + 0.036 * wind_speed) * 1e-3
  return(cd)
}

RHO_AIR <- 1.22  # kg/m³

wind_hourly <- wind_new_processed %>%
  mutate(
    wind_south_north  = -wind_speed * cos(wind_dir * pi / 180),
    Cd                = calculate_drag_coefficient_colleague(wind_speed),
    wind_stress       = wind_speed * wind_south_north * Cd * RHO_AIR,
    wind_speed_cubed  = wind_speed^3
  )

# ── 3. Daily aggregation (no rolling windows) ─────────────────────────────────

wind_daily <- wind_hourly %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_wind_speed        = mean(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    daily_wind_speed_cubed = mean(wind_speed_cubed, na.rm = TRUE),
    daily_wind_stress      = sum(wind_stress, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_hours                = n(),
    .groups                = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date))

cat("\n=== WIND DAILY SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(wind_daily$date)), "to",
    as.character(max(wind_daily$date)), "\n")
cat("Days with < 24 hours of data:\n")
print(wind_daily %>% filter(n_hours < 24) %>% select(date, n_hours))
```


```{r}
#Pulling out the median nightly buoy fluorescence value from my QC process
buoy_fl <- b_f %>% 
  select(date = date_corr, fl_med_day, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
  mutate(group = as.character(group))

ctd_fl <- ctd_fl %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date))

# Step 2: Apply chosen method (gaussian recommended)
buoy_fl_gapfilled <- fill_gap_with_discrete(
  df = buoy_fl,
  gap_start = as.Date("2025-04-27"),
  gap_end = as.Date("2025-05-11"),
  discrete_date = as.Date("2025-05-02"),
  discrete_value = 11.61,
  interpolation_method = "gaussian"
)

buoy_fl_gapfilled <- buoy_fl_gapfilled %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) 
```

```{r}
#Pulling out buoy salinity data without flags for 2022 and 2024 and calculating daily mean
buoy_ts <- buoy_ts %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(mean_sal = mean(WaterSalinity[WaterSalinity_UQL == 2], na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_temp = mean(WaterTemp[WaterTemp_UQL == 2], na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# More general approach - remove any temp/sal data within the gap
GAP_START <- as.Date("2025-04-27")
GAP_END <- as.Date("2025-05-11")

buoy_ts_clean <- buoy_ts %>%
  filter(!(date > GAP_START & date < GAP_END))

wind_dm <- wind %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(WindSpd_Med = median(WindSpd_Avg[WindSpd_UQL == 2], na.rm = TRUE),
            WindDir_Med = median(WindDir_Avg[WindDir_UQL == 2], na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date))
  
```

```{r}
#Working with chemtax data to make it easy to plot

#Making the date column a date format
chem <- chem %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::mdy(Date)) %>%
  select(date, cyan = Cyanobacteria, hapt = Hapto, 
         GA = `Prasinophytes-3`, cryp = Cryptophytes,
         dino = `Dinoflagellates-1`, raph = Raphido,
         dict = Dictyo, diat = `Diatoms-1`) %>% #rename groups
  pivot_longer(c(cyan:diat), names_to = "group",
               values_to = "contribution") %>%  #pivot longer
  group_by(date, group) %>% 
  summarise(contribution = mean(contribution)) %>% #Calculating daily mean for duplicates.
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(tchla = sum(contribution)) %>% #Calculating TChla concentrations for each day
  ungroup()


#checking to see if there are any duplicates - there were replicates taken for DFO comparisons. None found because I already averaged these for the manuscript.
chem_dup <- chem%>%
  distinct(date, tchla) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(dup = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(dup > 1)

#Good to move forward
```

```{r}
#Setting up the joined buoy surface discrete chlorophyll 2m nightly median fluorescence and 2m daily mean salinity/temperature for plotting - pivoting long.

buoy_fl_long <- buoy_fl %>%
  select(date, chla, fl_med_day, mean_sal, mean_temp, gap_filled) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(chla, fl_med_day, mean_sal, mean_temp),
               names_to = "par", values_to = "val") %>% 
  mutate(date = date(date),
         year = year(date),
         gap_filled = if_else(par == "fl_med_day", gap_filled, FALSE)) 
```

```{r}
#Creating buoy figure for 2022 - discrete surface chlorophyll, daily fluorescence/temp/sal
f_buoy_22 <- buoy_fl_long %>% 
  filter(year == 2022) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = val, color = par)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long,
                          par == "fl_med_day"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long,
                          par == "mean_sal"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long,
                          par == "mean_temp"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(buoy_fl_long,
                          par == "chla"),
            size = 4, pch = 8, stroke = 2) +
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(labels = c(expression(Chl[Discrete]),
                                         expression(Chl[BUOY]),
                                         expression(Salinity[BUOY]),
                                     expression(Temp[BUOY]))) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Chl~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")",
                       paste("Salinity,"~"Temp")))) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

print(f_buoy_22)
```

```{r}
                   "2019-05-11", "2020-04-30", "2021-04-10", "2022-03-05", 
                   "2023-04-01", "2024-03-18", "2025-03-25")),
  # tchla = c(5.27, 7.69, 4.27, 7.40, 4.98, 9.27, 9.18, 12.20, 10.31, 20.39, 7.05),
  type = c("Chl", "CTD", "HPLC", "Chl", "HPLC", "HPLC", "HPLC", 
           "Buoy", "Buoy", "Buoy", "Buoy")
)

sb_timing <- sb_timing %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date),
         yday = yday(date)) %>% 
  mutate(median_doy = median(yday))
```

```{r}
# ── Compute bloom timing reference dates mapped to 2025 ──────────────────────

bloom_min  <- as_date(paste0("2025-", format(as_date(min(sb_timing$yday) - 1, 
                              origin = "2025-01-01"), "%m-%d")))
bloom_max  <- as_date(paste0("2025-", format(as_date(max(sb_timing$yday) - 1, 
                              origin = "2025-01-01"), "%m-%d")))
bloom_mean <- as_date(mean(sb_timing$yday) - 1, origin = "2025-01-01")
bloom_2025 <- sb_timing %>% filter(year == 2025) %>% pull(date)

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

f_buoy_25 <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = val, color = par)) +
  # ── Bloom timing annotations (add first so they sit behind data) ──
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bloom_min, xmax = bloom_max,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bloom_mean,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bloom_2025,
             linetype = "solid", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 2) +
  # ── Buoy data ──
  geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long, year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day"),
            linewidth = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long, year == 2025, par == "mean_sal"),
            linewidth = 2) +
  # geom_line(data = filter(buoy_fl_long, year == 2025, par == "mean_temp"),
  #           linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(buoy_fl_long, year == 2025, par == "chla"),
             size = 4, pch = 8, stroke = 2) +
  # ── Scales ──
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(labels = c(expression(Chl[Discrete]),
                                      expression(Chl[BUOY]),
                                      expression(Salinity[BUOY])
                                     # ,
                                      # expression(Temp[BUOY]))
                                     )) +
  scale_x_date(limits     = as_date(c("2025-01-01", "2025-12-31")),
               expand      = c(0, 0),
               date_breaks = "months",
               date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Chl~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")",
                       paste("Salinity,"~"Temp")))) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "right",
```

```{r}
# ── Compute bloom timing reference dates mapped to 2025 ──────────────────────
bloom_min  <- as_date(paste0("2025-", format(as_date(min(sb_timing$yday) - 1,
                              origin = "2025-01-01"), "%m-%d")))
bloom_max  <- as_date(paste0("2025-", format(as_date(max(sb_timing$yday) - 1,
                              origin = "2025-01-01"), "%m-%d")))
bloom_mean <- as_date(mean(sb_timing$yday) - 1, origin = "2025-01-01")
bloom_2025 <- sb_timing %>% filter(year == 2025) %>% pull(date)

# ── Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# NA boundary rows for May gap-filled period (breaks solid line)
may_gap_na <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day", gap_filled == TRUE) %>%
  slice(1, n()) %>%
  mutate(val = NA_real_)

# NA boundary rows for July gap
july_gap_na_fl <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day") %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-07-09") | date == as.Date("2025-07-14")) %>%
  mutate(val = NA_real_)

july_gap_na_sal <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "mean_sal") %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-07-09") | date == as.Date("2025-07-14")) %>%
  mutate(val = NA_real_)

# fl_med_day solid: non-gap-filled rows + NA boundaries for both gaps
fl_solid <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day", gap_filled == FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(may_gap_na) %>%
  bind_rows(july_gap_na_fl) %>%
  arrange(date)

# fl_med_day dashed: gap-filled rows + neighbouring solid points for connectivity
fl_dashed <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day", gap_filled == TRUE) %>%
  bind_rows(
    buoy_fl_long %>%
      filter(year == 2025, par == "fl_med_day", gap_filled == FALSE) %>%
      filter(
        date == max(date[date < min(buoy_fl_long$date[buoy_fl_long$year == 2025 &
                                                       buoy_fl_long$par == "fl_med_day" &
                                                       buoy_fl_long$gap_filled == TRUE])]) |
        date == min(date[date > max(buoy_fl_long$date[buoy_fl_long$year == 2025 &
                                                       buoy_fl_long$par == "fl_med_day" &
                                                       buoy_fl_long$gap_filled == TRUE])])
      )
  ) %>%
  arrange(date)

# Salinity with July gap NA boundaries
sal_data <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025, par == "mean_sal") %>%
  bind_rows(july_gap_na_sal) %>%
  arrange(date)

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_buoy_25 <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = val, color = par)) +
  # ── Bloom timing annotations ──
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bloom_min, xmax = bloom_max,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bloom_mean,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bloom_2025,
             linetype = "solid", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 2) +
  # ── fl_med_day solid ──
  geom_line(data = fl_solid, aes(x = date, y = val),
            linewidth = 2) +
  # ── fl_med_day dashed (gap-filled) ──
  geom_line(data = fl_dashed, aes(x = date, y = val),
            linewidth = 2, linetype = "dashed") +
  # ── Salinity ──
  geom_line(data = sal_data, aes(x = date, y = val),
            linewidth = 2) +
  # ── Discrete chla ──
  geom_point(data = filter(buoy_fl_long, year == 2025, par == "chla"),
             size = 4, pch = 8, stroke = 2) +
  # ── Scales ──
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(labels = c(expression(Chl[Discrete]),
                                     expression(Chl[BUOY]),
                                     expression(Salinity[BUOY]))) +
  scale_x_date(limits     = as_date(c("2025-01-01", "2025-12-31")),
               expand      = c(0, 0),
               date_breaks = "months",
               date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Chl~"(mg"~m^-3*")", "Salinity"))) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        text            = element_text(size = 35),
        axis.text       = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x     = element_blank())

print(f_buoy_25)

ggsave(here("figures", "buoy_2025_bloom_timing.png"),
       plot = f_buoy_25, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(names_from = par, values_from = val) %>%
  filter(month(date) %in% 6:7) %>%
  summarise(

    cor_fl_temp = cor(fl_med_day, mean_temp, use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
# ── Scatter: same-day temp vs fluorescence, 2025 Jun-Jul ─────────────────────

scatter_2025 <- buoy_fl_long %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = par, values_from = val) %>%
  filter(month(date) %in% 6:7) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fl_med_day), !is.na(mean_temp)) %>%
  mutate(log_fl = log(fl_med_day + 0.1))

lm_log <- lm(log_fl ~ mean_temp, data = scatter_2025)
r2   <- round(summary(lm_log)$r.squared, 2)
pval <- format.pval(summary(lm_log)$coefficients[2, 4], digits = 2)

ggplot(scatter_2025, aes(x = mean_temp, y = log_fl)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", alpha = 0.6, size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r2, "\np = ", pval),
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 10) +
  labs(x     = expression(Temperature~(degree*C)),
       y     = expression(log(Chl)~(mg~m^-3)),
       title = "2025: cold conditions associated with bloom pulses (Jun\u2013Jul)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 35) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave(here("figures", "scatter_temp_fl_2025_junjul.png"),
       width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#Setting color palette

# Option 3: Viridis-inspired but with dark blue start
fluor_palette_v3 <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#08306b",  # Deep navy blue
  "#1f4e7a",  # Dark blue
  "#2e6b89",  # Medium blue
  "#4d8fc7",  # Bright blue
  "#2fb3d4",  # Vivid cyan-blue (bloom threshold)
  "#00a693",  # Bright teal
  "#4daf4a",  # Vibrant green
  "#8cc152",  # Lime green
  "#ffd23f",  # Bright yellow
  "#ff8c42",  # Vivid orange
  "#e74c3c"   # Bold red-orange
))

# Generate color vectors (50 colors for smooth gradients)
colors_v3 <- fluor_palette_v3(50)

# Function to create breaks that emphasize bloom threshold
create_fluor_breaks <- function(max_val = 50, bloom_threshold = 5) {
  # More breaks in the 0-10 range to capture bloom dynamics
  c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, bloom_threshold, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, max_val)
}

overall_range <- ctd_fl %>% 
  filter(pres < 51) %>% 
  summarise(min_val = min(f_final, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_val = max(f_final, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#Creating CTD profile plot for each year.

f_ctd_fl_22 <- ctd_fl %>% 
  filter(pres < 51 & year == 2022) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = pres, fill = f_final)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5,
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "white") +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = colors_v3,
                     values = scales::rescale(c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)),
                     limits = c(overall_range$min_val, overall_range$max_val)) +
  labs(fill = bquote(CTD[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
       y = "Depth") +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 38), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.height = unit(1.8, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30, angle = 270),
        legend.title.align = 0.5,
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.text.x = element_blank()
        ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "right"))

print(f_ctd_fl_22)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# PHYTOPLANKTON BLOOM DETECTION & VISUALIZATION
# ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)

# ============================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================
SMOOTHING_ENABLED <- FALSE
SMOOTHING_PERIOD <- 0
SMOOTHING_TYPE <- "median"
MIN_BLOOM_DAYS <- 7
THRESHOLD_PERCENT <- 1.15     # 5% above median
GAP_TOLERANCE <- 0            # Bridge gaps between blooms (0 = strict)
USE_TIMESERIES_MEDIAN <- TRUE # TRUE = time-series median, FALSE = annual median
EXCLUDE_YEARS <- c(2023)      # Years with incomplete data to exclude

# ============================================
# BLOOM DETECTION FUNCTION
# ============================================
calculate_bloom_metrics <- function(df, 
                                  gap_tolerance = GAP_TOLERANCE, 
                                  smoothing = SMOOTHING_ENABLED,
                                  min_bloom_days = MIN_BLOOM_DAYS,
                                  threshold_percent = THRESHOLD_PERCENT,
                                  smoothing_period = SMOOTHING_PERIOD,
                                  smoothing_type = SMOOTHING_TYPE,
                                  use_timeseries_median = USE_TIMESERIES_MEDIAN,
                                  exclude_years = EXCLUDE_YEARS) {
  
  if (!smoothing_type %in% c("mean", "median")) {
    stop("smoothing_type must be either 'mean' or 'median'")
  }
  
  # Remove excluded years
  if (!is.null(exclude_years) && length(exclude_years) > 0) {
    df <- df %>% filter(!year %in% exclude_years)
    message(paste("Excluded years:", paste(exclude_years, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Calculate time-series median if requested
  if (use_timeseries_median) {
    timeseries_median <- median(df$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    timeseries_threshold <- timeseries_median * threshold_percent
    message(sprintf("Using time-series median: %.2f (threshold: %.2f)", 
                   timeseries_median, timeseries_threshold))
  }
  
  all_bloom_events <- data.frame()
  bloom_summary <- data.frame()
  
  for (yr in unique(df$year)) {
    
    year_data <- df %>% 
      filter(year == yr) %>%
      arrange(date)
    
    if (nrow(year_data) < 30) {
      warning(paste("Insufficient data for year", yr, "(<30 observations) - skipping"))
      next
    }
    
    # Apply smoothing if requested
    if (smoothing && smoothing_period > 1) {
      smooth_fn <- if (smoothing_type == "mean") zoo::rollmean else zoo::rollmedian
      year_data$fl_smoothed <- smooth_fn(year_data$fl_med_day, 
                                         k = smoothing_period, 
                                         fill = NA, 
                                         align = "center")
      year_data$fl_smoothed[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)] <- 
        year_data$fl_med_day[is.na(year_data$fl_smoothed)]
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_smoothed
    } else {
      comparison_var <- year_data$fl_med_day
    }
    
    # Define bloom threshold (time-series or annual)
    if (use_timeseries_median) {
      reference_median <- timeseries_median
      bloom_threshold <- timeseries_threshold
    } else {
      reference_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
      bloom_threshold <- reference_median * threshold_percent
    }
    
    # Identify periods above threshold
    year_data$above_threshold <- comparison_var > bloom_threshold
    
    # Bridge short gaps if requested
    if (gap_tolerance > 0) {
      rle_result <- rle(year_data$above_threshold)
      
      for (i in 2:(length(rle_result$lengths) - 1)) {
        if (!rle_result$values[i] && 
            rle_result$lengths[i] <= gap_tolerance &&
            rle_result$values[i-1] && 
            rle_result$values[i+1]) {
          rle_result$values[i] <- TRUE
        }
      }
      year_data$above_threshold <- inverse.rle(rle_result)
    }
    
    # Identify bloom periods
    year_data$group <- cumsum(c(1, diff(year_data$above_threshold) != 0))
    
    bloom_periods <- year_data %>%
      group_by(group, above_threshold) %>%
      summarise(
        start_date = min(date),
        end_date = max(date),
        duration = n(),
        max_fl = max(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_fl_date = date[which.max(fl_med_day)],
        mean_fl = mean(fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      filter(above_threshold & duration >= min_bloom_days)
    
    # Calculate annual metrics
    annual_median <- median(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    annual_peak_fl <- max(year_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE)
    annual_peak_date <- year_data$date[which.max(year_data$fl_med_day)]
    
    if (nrow(bloom_periods) > 0) {
      bloom_events <- bloom_periods %>%
        mutate(
          year = yr,
          bloom_number = row_number(),
          start_yday = yday(start_date),
          end_yday = yday(end_date)
        ) %>%
        select(year, bloom_number, start_date, end_date, start_yday, end_yday,
               duration, max_fl, max_fl_date, mean_fl)
      
      all_bloom_events <- bind_rows(all_bloom_events, bloom_events)
      
      year_summary <- tibble(
        year = yr,
        n_bloom_events = nrow(bloom_periods),
        spring_bloom_start = min(bloom_periods$start_date),
        spring_bloom_yday = yday(min(bloom_periods$start_date)),
        total_bloom_days = sum(bloom_periods$duration),
        annual_median = annual_median,
        reference_median = reference_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_yday = yday(annual_peak_date)
      )
    } else {
      year_summary <- tibble(
        year = yr,
        n_bloom_events = 0,
        spring_bloom_start = as.Date(NA),
        spring_bloom_yday = NA_integer_,
        total_bloom_days = 0,
        annual_median = annual_median,
        reference_median = reference_median,
        bloom_threshold = bloom_threshold,
        annual_peak_fl = annual_peak_fl,
        annual_peak_yday = yday(annual_peak_date)
      )
    }
    
    bloom_summary <- bind_rows(bloom_summary, year_summary)
  }
  
  return(list(
    annual_summary = bloom_summary,
    bloom_events = all_bloom_events,
    parameters = list(
      gap_tolerance = gap_tolerance,
      smoothing = smoothing,
      smoothing_period = smoothing_period,
      min_bloom_days = min_bloom_days,
      threshold_percent = threshold_percent,
      use_timeseries_median = use_timeseries_median,
      timeseries_median = if(use_timeseries_median) timeseries_median else NA,
      excluded_years = exclude_years
    )
  ))
}

# ============================================
# VISUALIZATION FUNCTION
# ============================================
plot_bloom_detection <- function(bloom_results, data, 
                                problematic_dates = NULL,
                                save_path = NULL) {
  
  annual_summary <- bloom_results$annual_summary
  bloom_events <- bloom_results$bloom_events
  params <- bloom_results$parameters
  
  # Filter data to years with results
  plot_data <- data %>% 
    filter(year %in% unique(annual_summary$year))
  
  # Remove problematic dates if specified
  if (!is.null(problematic_dates)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(!date %in% problematic_dates)
  }
  
  # Calculate global y-axis limits
  global_y_max <- max(plot_data$fl_med_day, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  
  # Create individual year plot
  create_year_plot <- function(yr) {
    
    year_data <- plot_data %>% filter(year == yr)
    year_blooms <- bloom_events %>% filter(year == yr)
    year_summary <- annual_summary %>% filter(year == yr)
    
    if (nrow(year_data) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Determine which median to show
    if (params$use_timeseries_median) {
      median_val <- year_summary$reference_median
      median_label <- "Time-series median"
      median_color <- "#4169E1"
    } else {
      median_val <- year_summary$annual_median
      median_label <- "Annual median"
      median_color <- "#4169E1"
    }
    
    # Build plot
    p <- ggplot(year_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day)) +
      # Bloom periods
      {if (nrow(year_blooms) > 0) {
        list(
          geom_rect(data = year_blooms, 
                    aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date, 
                        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                    fill = "red", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE),
          geom_text(data = year_blooms,
                    aes(x = start_date + (end_date - start_date)/2, 
                        y = global_y_max * 0.95,
                        label = paste0("B", bloom_number)),
                    size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "darkred",
                    inherit.aes = FALSE)
        )
      }} +
      # Fluorescence line
      geom_line(color = "#2E8B57", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
      # Threshold lines
      geom_hline(yintercept = median_val, 
                 linetype = "dashed", color = median_color, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = year_summary$bloom_threshold, 
                 linetype = "solid", color = "#DC143C", linewidth = 0.8) +
      # Formatting
      scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b",
                   limits = c(as.Date(paste0(yr, "-01-01")), 
                             as.Date(paste0(yr, "-12-31")))) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, global_y_max)) +
      labs(
        title = yr,
        x = "",
        y = "Fluorescence",
        subtitle = sprintf("Blooms: %d | Threshold: %.2f | %s: %.2f",
                          year_summary$n_bloom_events,
                          year_summary$bloom_threshold,
                          if(params$use_timeseries_median) "TS Median" else "Annual Median",
                          median_val)
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 5)
      )
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Generate all year plots
  year_plots <- lapply(sort(unique(annual_summary$year)), create_year_plot)
  year_plots <- year_plots[!sapply(year_plots, is.null)]
  
  if (length(year_plots) == 0) {
    stop("No valid plots generated")
  }
  
  # Determine grid layout
  n_years <- length(year_plots)
  ncol <- if (n_years <= 2) 1 else 2
  nrow <- ceiling(n_years / ncol)
  
  # Create combined plot
  combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(
    year_plots, 
    ncol = ncol, 
    nrow = nrow,
    top = "Phytoplankton Bloom Detection Results"
  ))
  
  # Print summary
  cat("\n=== BLOOM DETECTION SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Method Configuration:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  - Median type: %s\n", 
              if(params$use_timeseries_median) "Time-series" else "Annual"))
  if (params$use_timeseries_median) {
    cat(sprintf("  - Time-series median: %.2f\n", params$timeseries_median))
  }
  cat(sprintf("  - Threshold: %.0f%% above median\n", 
              (params$threshold_percent - 1) * 100))
  cat(sprintf("  - Minimum bloom duration: %d days\n", params$min_bloom_days))
  cat(sprintf("  - Gap tolerance: %d days\n", params$gap_tolerance))
  cat(sprintf("  - Smoothing: %s", ifelse(params$smoothing, "YES", "NO")))
  if (params$smoothing && params$smoothing_period > 1) {
    cat(sprintf(" (%d-day %s)", params$smoothing_period, params$smoothing_type))
  }
  cat("\n")
  if (!is.null(params$excluded_years) && length(params$excluded_years) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  - Excluded years: %s\n", paste(params$excluded_years, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  summary_table <- annual_summary %>%
    select(year, n_bloom_events, spring_bloom_yday, annual_peak_yday, 
           total_bloom_days, annual_median, reference_median, bloom_threshold) %>%
    mutate(
      spring_bloom_yday = ifelse(is.na(spring_bloom_yday), 
                                "No bloom", 
                                paste("Day", spring_bloom_yday)),
      annual_peak_yday = paste("Day", annual_peak_yday),
      across(c(annual_median, reference_median, bloom_threshold), ~round(.x, 2))
    )
  
  print(summary_table)
  
  cat("\n=== PLOT LEGEND ===\n")
  cat("Green line: Daily fluorescence measurements\n")
  cat(sprintf("Blue dashed: %s fluorescence\n", 
              if(params$use_timeseries_median) "Time-series median" else "Annual median"))
  cat(sprintf("Red solid: Bloom threshold (+%.0f%% above median)\n", 
              (params$threshold_percent - 1) * 100))
  cat("Red shading: Detected bloom periods\n")
  cat("B1, B2, etc.: Bloom event numbers\n")
  
  # Save if path provided
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, combined_plot,
           width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("\nPlot saved to: %s\n", save_path))
  }
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# ============================================
# RUN BLOOM DETECTION
# ============================================

# Run with time-series median (recommended)
bloom_metrics <- calculate_bloom_metrics(buoy_fl_gapfilled)

# Generate plots
combined_plot <- plot_bloom_detection(
  bloom_results = bloom_metrics,
  data = buoy_fl_gapfilled,
  save_path = here("figures", "bloom_detection_timeseries.png")
)

# ============================================
# OPTIONAL: COMPARE METHODS
# ============================================

# Compare time-series vs annual median approaches
compare_methods <- function(data) {
  
  cat("\n========================================")
  cat("\nCOMPARISON: Time-Series vs Annual Median")
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  
  # Time-series approach
  cat("\n--- TIME-SERIES MEDIAN APPROACH ---\n")
  bloom_ts <- calculate_bloom_metrics(data, use_timeseries_median = TRUE)
  
  # Annual approach
  cat("\n--- ANNUAL MEDIAN APPROACH ---\n")
  bloom_annual <- calculate_bloom_metrics(data, use_timeseries_median = FALSE)
  
  # Compare results
  comparison <- bloom_ts$annual_summary %>%
    select(year, n_bloom_events) %>%
    rename(blooms_timeseries = n_bloom_events) %>%
    left_join(
      bloom_annual$annual_summary %>%
        select(year, n_bloom_events) %>%
        rename(blooms_annual = n_bloom_events),
      by = "year"
    ) %>%
    mutate(difference = blooms_timeseries - blooms_annual)
  
  cat("\n=== BLOOM COUNT COMPARISON ===\n")
  print(comparison)
  
  cat("\n=== THRESHOLD COMPARISON ===\n")
  threshold_comparison <- bloom_ts$annual_summary %>%
    select(year, reference_median, bloom_threshold) %>%
    rename(ts_median = reference_median, ts_threshold = bloom_threshold) %>%
    left_join(
      bloom_annual$annual_summary %>%
        select(year, reference_median, bloom_threshold) %>%
        rename(annual_median = reference_median, annual_threshold = bloom_threshold),
      by = "year"
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2)))
  
  print(threshold_comparison)
  
  return(list(timeseries = bloom_ts, annual = bloom_annual))
}

# Run comparison (optional)
# comparison_results <- compare_methods(buoy_fl)
```

```{r}


# ============================================
# VISUALIZATION OF GAP-FILLING
# ============================================

plot_gap_filling <- function(original_data, filled_data, 
                            gap_start, gap_end, 
                            zoom_days = 40,
                            save_path = NULL) {
  
  # Create zoom window around gap
  zoom_start <- gap_start - days(zoom_days/2)
  zoom_end <- gap_end + days(zoom_days/2)
  
  plot_data <- filled_data %>%
    filter(date >= zoom_start, date <= zoom_end)
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day)) +
    # Gap region
    annotate("rect", 
             xmin = gap_start, xmax = gap_end,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "gray90", alpha = 0.5) +
    # Original data
    geom_line(data = plot_data %>% filter(!gap_filled),
              aes(color = "Original data"), 
              linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(!gap_filled),
               aes(color = "Original data"),
               size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Interpolated data
    geom_line(data = plot_data %>% filter(gap_filled),
              aes(color = "Interpolated"), 
              linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(gap_filled),
               aes(color = "Interpolated"),
               size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Discrete sample
    geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(discrete_anchor),
               aes(color = "Discrete sample"),
               size = 5, shape = 18) +
    # Styling
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "",
      values = c("Original data" = "#2E8B57",
                 "Interpolated" = "#FF8C00",
                 "Discrete sample" = "#DC143C"),
      breaks = c("Original data", "Interpolated", "Discrete sample")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Gap-Filling with Discrete Chlorophyll Sample",
      subtitle = sprintf("Gap: %s to %s", gap_start, gap_end),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Fluorescence (mg/m³)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("Gap-filling plot saved to: %s\n", save_path))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# ============================================
# COMPARE INTERPOLATION METHODS
# ============================================

compare_interpolation_methods <- function(data, gap_start, gap_end, 
                                         discrete_date, discrete_value,
                                         save_path = NULL) {
  
  methods <- c("gaussian", "spline", "asymmetric")
  results <- list()
  
  cat("\n=== COMPARING INTERPOLATION METHODS ===\n")
  for (method in methods) {
    cat(sprintf("\nTesting: %s\n", method))
    results[[method]] <- fill_gap_with_discrete(
      df = data,
      gap_start = gap_start,
      gap_end = gap_end,
      discrete_date = discrete_date,
      discrete_value = discrete_value,
      interpolation_method = method
    )
  }
  
  # Plot comparison
  zoom_start <- gap_start - days(15)
  zoom_end <- gap_end + days(15)
  
  comparison_data <- bind_rows(
    results$gaussian %>% 
      filter(date >= zoom_start, date <= zoom_end) %>%
      mutate(method = "Gaussian (recommended)"),
    results$spline %>% 
      filter(date >= zoom_start, date <= zoom_end) %>%
      mutate(method = "Cubic Spline"),
    results$asymmetric %>% 
      filter(date >= zoom_start, date <= zoom_end) %>%
      mutate(method = "Asymmetric (exp rise)")
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(comparison_data, aes(x = date, y = fl_med_day, color = method)) +
    annotate("rect", 
             xmin = gap_start, xmax = gap_end,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "gray90", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = comparison_data %>% filter(discrete_anchor),
               size = 4, shape = 18, color = "black") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Interpolation Method") +
    labs(
      title = "Comparison of Gap-Filling Methods",
      subtitle = sprintf("Discrete sample: %s = %.2f mg/m³", 
                        discrete_date, discrete_value),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Fluorescence (mg/m³)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("\nComparison plot saved to: %s\n", save_path))
  }
  
  print(p)
  return(results)
}

# ============================================
# USAGE EXAMPLE
# ============================================

# Step 1: Compare methods to choose best fit
interpolation_comparison <- compare_interpolation_methods(
  data = buoy_fl,
  gap_start = as.Date("2025-04-27"),
  gap_end = as.Date("2025-05-11"),
  discrete_date = as.Date("2025-05-02"),
  discrete_value = 11.61,
  save_path = here("figures", "interpolation_comparison.png")
)



# Step 3: Visualize the gap-filling
gap_plot <- plot_gap_filling(
  original_data = buoy_fl,
  filled_data = buoy_fl_gapfilled,
  gap_start = as.Date("2025-04-27"),
  gap_end = as.Date("2025-05-11"),
  zoom_days = 40,
  save_path = here("figures", "gap_filling_2025.png")
)

# Step 4: Run bloom detection on gap-filled data
bloom_metrics_gapfilled <- calculate_bloom_metrics(buoy_fl_gapfilled)

combined_plot <- plot_bloom_detection(
  bloom_results = bloom_metrics_gapfilled,
  data = buoy_fl_gapfilled,
  save_path = here("figures", "bloom_detection_gapfilled.png")
)
```
